commits.message:
[KV Connector][Spec Decode] Support lookahead block hashes in remaining KV connectors (#65448)

Signed-off-by: Dakai An <dakaian108@gmail.com>

affected_interfaces: vllm.distributed.kv_transfer.kv_connector.v1.base.KVConnectorBase_V1.supports_lookahead_block_hashes: default returned value changes False -> True, so every vllm-ascend connector that does not override it silently starts advertising lookahead-hash support

vllm_ascend/distributed/kv_transfer/kv_pool/ascend_store/coordinator.py::AscendStoreCoordinator (__init__, _reachable_masks, find_longest_cache_hit, store_mask): has no num_hash_lookahead_tokens, hardcodes the replay boundary as num_prompt_tokens-1, and derives use_eagle from spec.use_eagle() without excluding lookahead

vllm_ascend/distributed/kv_transfer/kv_pool/ascend_store/pool_scheduler.py::BaseKVPoolScheduler/KVPoolScheduler and layerwise/pool_scheduler.py::LayerwiseKVPoolScheduler (__init__, _build_cache_coordinator, get_num_new_matched_tokens/_lookup_external_hit_tokens, _lookup_layerwise_*): use_eagle and lookup token_len/block-hash slicing must follow the lookahead policy

vllm_ascend/distributed/kv_transfer/kv_pool/ascend_store/pool_worker.py::BaseKVPoolWorker/KVPoolWorker and layerwise/pool_worker.py::LayerwiseKVPoolWorker (__init__, _build_cache_coordinator, store paths around BlockStored): coordinator/use_eagle wiring and BlockStored.lookahead_token_ids

vllm_ascend/distributed/kv_transfer/kv_pool/ascend_store/kv_transfer.py and metadata.py (BlockStored construction, RequestMeta.save ranges/available_full_block_count): hashes now cover lookahead tokens and are fewer than full blocks

vllm_ascend/distributed/kv_transfer/kv_p2p/mooncake/base_scheduler.py::MooncakeBaseConnectorScheduler._truncate_request_for_prefill and the same logic in mooncake_connector.py, mooncake_hybrid_connector.py, mooncake_layerwise_connector.py: block_hashes.clear()+update_block_hashes() must remain lookahead-correct after dropping the last prompt token

vllm_ascend/distributed/kv_transfer/kv_p2p/mooncake_d2rh_connector.py::MooncakeConnectorScheduler._d2rh_get_decode_endpoint_hashes (and _d2rh_prefix_fingerprint/_d2rh_get_transfer_block_hashes): the guard len(block_hashes) < len(tokens)//hash_block_size disables the decode host-cache optimization whenever lookahead is enabled

vllm_ascend/distributed/kv_transfer/kv_pool/kv_offload/preempt_offload/manager.py::PreemptOffloadScheduler: builds its CPU KVCacheCoordinator without num_hash_lookahead_tokens and with use_eagle=False

vllm_ascend/distributed/kv_transfer/ascend_multi_connector.py::AscendMultiConnector plus child connectors MooncakeBaseConnector/MooncakeConnector(s), MooncakeD2RHConnectorV1, AscendStoreConnector, SfaRemoteD2HConnector, UCMConnectorV1, PreemptOffloadConnectorV1: all inherit the flipped default; AscendMultiConnector now reports True only if children do

vllm_ascend/distributed/kv_transfer/kv_pool/kv_offload/simple/simple_cpu_offload_connector.py::AscendSimpleCPUOffloadConnector and kv_offload/native/offloading_connector.py::AscendOffloadingConnector: inherit upstream connectors whose managers/replay boundaries are now lookahead-aware; verify the NPU worker/coordinator wiring and config propagation
deep_analysis.adaptation_guide:
1) Treat the base-class default flip as an API contract change: for every vllm-ascend connector that is not yet lookahead-correct, either implement lookahead-safe handling or add an explicit classmethod supports_lookahead_block_hashes(cls, kv_transfer_config) -> False until qualified. This is required because no vllm-ascend connector currently overrides it.
2) AscendStore: thread vllm_config.num_hash_lookahead_tokens into AscendStoreCoordinator (from both KVPoolScheduler._build_cache_coordinator and KVPoolWorker._build_cache_coordinator, including layerwise variants). In AscendStoreCoordinator.__init__ store it and make use_eagle mean use_eagle_block_drop and not num_hash_lookahead_tokens (mirror upstream UMBP: use_eagle = spec.use_eagle_block_drop() and not L). In _reachable_masks change the store/replay boundary from (max(0, num_prompt_tokens - 1),) to (max(0, num_prompt_tokens - max(1, L)),), matching upstream replay_boundaries/offloading. Audit _find_hit_blocks and ExternalCachedBlockPool for any len(block_hashes)==full-block assumptions.
3) AscendStore save/event paths: when building BlockStored in kv_transfer.py (~line 926) and layerwise/pool_worker.py (~line 1814), pass lookahead_token_ids (request.all_token_ids[block_end:block_end+L]) when L>0, and ensure token_ids/extra_keys follow generate_lookahead_block_hash_extra_keys semantics; otherwise KV-event consumers cannot reconstruct lookahead block hashes. Ensure the final request-finished save publishes the block whose hash became available with the last sampled token (equivalent of upstream UMBP _register_finished_lookahead_save), and cap lookup/save token lengths at len(block_hashes)*hash_block_size where upstream does (UMBP lookup_limit, lmcache len(all_token_ids)//block_size vs len(block_hashes)).
4) Mooncake P/D schedulers: keep the existing truncate-and-recompute pattern but make it lookahead-correct; preferably replace block_hashes.clear(); update_block_hashes() with request.truncate_block_hashes(hash_block_size, num_hash_lookahead_tokens) (also clears _prompt_embeds_per_block_hashes), or verify recomputation produces exactly the shortened hash list. Confirm _state_prefill_token_count/get_num_new_matched_tokens and request_finished block slicing do not assume len(block_hashes) == num_prompt_tokens/block_size.
5) MooncakeD2RH: make _d2rh_get_decode_endpoint_hashes lookahead-aware. Its guard must allow the reduced usable hash count (e.g. compare against max(0, len(tokens)-L)//hash_block_size and continue hashing the uncovered tail), otherwise every EAGLE/MTP lookahead run returns None and silently disables the D2RH host-cache fast path. Re-check _d2rh_prefix_fingerprint/_d2rh_get_transfer_block_hashes so they hash the non-covered tail tokens rather than assuming every complete block has a hash.
6) PreemptOffload: pass num_hash_lookahead_tokens=vllm_config.num_hash_lookahead_tokens to get_kv_cache_coordinator in PreemptOffloadScheduler and derive use_eagle as use_eagle_block_drop and not L, so its CPU BlockPool events/reachability match the GPU pool and the newly enabled hashes.
7) AscendMultiConnector: verify the inherited MultiConnector.supports_lookahead_block_hashes ANDs children correctly, and that any child left explicitly False forces the whole composite to fall back to L=0. For UCMConnectorV1 and SfaRemoteD2HConnector, either qualify the delegated external engine/backend for lookahead keys or override supports_lookahead_block_hashes -> False.
8) Add vllm-ascend unit tests mirroring upstream test_lookahead_finish_saves_only_computed_kv, test_lazy_prefix_chain_skips_blocks_without_lookahead_hash, test_external_hit_uses_the_same_lookahead_policy_as_core, and the lmcache range tests, plus tests that PreemptOffload/offloading CPU boundaries and AscendStore reachable masks use num_prompt_tokens - max(1, L).
deep_analysis.risk: medium-high. The commit is a true behavioral change for out-of-tree connectors: because the base default flips to True, EAGLE/EAGLE3/MTP with block dropping plus any Ascend KV connector will start computing and exchanging lookahead-qualified block hashes without vllm-ascend opting in. Hash counts become smaller than full-block counts, so any code that equates len(block_hashes) with complete blocks or uses num_prompt_tokens-1 as the replay boundary can under/over-estimate reachable prefixes, skip valid cache hits, or serve a boundary the rescan cannot reproduce. AscendStore's independent use_eagle/drop policy and the AscendStore/KV-event paths are the highest correctness risk; D2RH's decode-hash guard is a likely performance regression (optimization silently disabled). Mooncake P/D truncation recomputes hashes and is probably safe, but needs verification. Test coverage for these connectors with lookahead is currently absent.

deep_analysis.adaptation_guide: The functional interval reset is inherited via AscendEplbState.step -> super().step() because it keys off model_state.rebalanced, which Ascend already maintains. However, Ascend fully replaces the upstream async worker and the per-layer commit path, so the new progress contract must be wired manually: (1) In vllm_ascend/patch/platform/patch_eplb.py::_wrap_async_worker._run, mirror vllm/distributed/eplb/async_worker.py::_transfer_cycle by setting model_state.worker_progress = 2 * layer_idx immediately before _async_worker.transfer_layer(...) and model_state.worker_progress = 2 * layer_idx + 1 after publishing model_state.pending_result (before consumed_event.wait), using the actual layer_idx from changed_layers rather than the upstream sequential index. (2) In _move_changed_layer_to_workspace, set model_state.num_committed_layers = result.layer_idx + 1 after _commit_ascend_maps_for_layer so the new 'N/num_moe_layers layers committed' overrun message is accurate; leave the no-op/last-result branch consistent. (3) In AscendEplbState.publish_async_load_stats (the custom async load-stats path that bypasses EplbState.rearrange), reset model_state.num_committed_layers = 0 and model_state.worker_progress = -1 before setting rebalanced = True, mirroring the two new lines added to upstream rearrange; optionally do the same in drain_async/close. (4) Update Ascend UTs (tests/ut/patch/platform/test_patch_eplb.py, tests/ut/worker/v2/test_eplb_load_collection_phase.py) to assert the progress fields and the new overrun-warning behavior, since Ascend's custom worker is what now needs to feed _warn_async_rearrangement_in_progress.
deep_analysis.risk: Low. Not wiring the fields does not break correctness or hang: AscendEplbState inherits EplbModelState defaults (num_committed_layers=0, worker_progress=-1), so the new EP-group all-reduce in _warn_async_rearrangement_in_progress still runs on every rank and only the diagnostics ('computing the new placement', 0/N committed) become misleading. The main invariant to preserve is that all EP ranks make identical in-progress/warning decisions, which Ascend's coordinated rebalanced flag already guarantees; the warning uses get_ep_group() while Ascend transfers use get_eplb_group(), so there is no new collective-ordering conflict. Without the publish-path reset, stale values could persist across Ascend custom-policy cycles and produce wrong overrun logs. Upstream config/tests changes are documentation/UT only and need no Ascend code change.

affected_interfaces: vllm_ascend.models.deepseek_v41.compressor.DeepseekV41Compressor.__init__ — builds the ratio-2 V4.1 state-cache spec via AscendCircularBufferSpec/CircularBufferSpec without max_tp_shards
vllm_ascend.attention.dsa_v41.DeepseekV41CacheLayer.get_kv_cache_spec — returns the compressor state spec unchanged to the planner
vllm_ascend.models.deepseek_v41.cache_config.make_swa_cache_spec and AscendSlidingWindowMLASpec.merge — related pre-existing TP-replication gap for the V4.1 SWA group
deep_analysis.adaptation_guide: Upstream CompressorStateCache.get_kv_cache_spec() now declares max_tp_shards=1 so vLLM's kv_cache_groups_tp_replicas()/tp_replicated_group_ids() treat the DeepSeek V4.1 compressor state cache as byte-identical across TP ranks and allow one shared CPU copy in the tiering offload connector. vllm-ascend does not use upstream CompressorStateCache for V4.1; it has its own DeepseekV41Compressor, so the flag must be added there. In vllm_ascend/models/deepseek_v41/compressor.py, the ratio-2 branch (around lines 35-47) constructs state_spec(block_size=STATE_RING_ROWS, num_kv_heads=1, head_size=2*self.width, dtype=torch.float32, head_size_v=0) with state_spec = AscendCircularBufferSpec or CircularBufferSpec, neither of which sets max_tp_shards (inherits AttentionSpec default None). Add max_tp_shards=1 to that constructor call. Also audit the V4.1 SWA path: vllm_ascend/models/deepseek_v41/cache_config.py:make_swa_cache_spec builds AscendSlidingWindowMLASpec without max_tp_shards, and AscendSlidingWindowMLASpec.merge (vllm_ascend/core/kv_cache_interface.py) rebuilds the spec without carrying max_tp_shards; upstream DeepseekV4SWACache already declares max_tp_shards=1 (vllm/v1/attention/backends/mla/sparse_swa.py:132). Because kv_cache_groups_tp_replicas() takes the gcd over every layer spec, one unset group (state or SWA) still forces kv_tp_replicas=1, so for the feature to actually engage on V4.1 both groups must declare 1 and merge must preserve it. Add/extend a unit test (mirroring tests/models/test_deepseek_v41_pcp.py::test_cache_specs_declare_tp_replication, or tests/ut/core/test_kv_tp_replicas.py) asserting the V4.1 compressor state spec (and SWA spec) report max_tp_shards == 1. Leave NPUOffloadingSpec alone (single-tier intentionally disables replicated_layout); the behavior surfaces through NPUTieringOffloadingSpec.
deep_analysis.risk: Low-to-medium. The change only adds metadata; no signature changes and no direct import of the modified upstream module, so nothing breaks. Correctness risk is that max_tp_shards=1 asserts each TP rank's compressor ring state (and SWA cache) is byte-identical; if ratio-2 pooling/ring writes ever become rank-dependent, the tiering connector would share one CPU copy and return wrong KV on reload. In practice wkv/wgate are replicated and the ring is per-request, so this should hold. PCP/DCP already opt out (tp_replicated_group_ids returns empty when pcp_size>1 or dcp_size>1), and upstream replicated_layout also requires PP=PCP=DCP=1, mp backend, single node. Validate with a TP>1 V4.1 tiering-offload reload and confirm kv_cache_config.kv_tp_replicas == tensor_parallel_size before enabling.

affected_interfaces: vllm_ascend/ops/fused_moe/fused_moe.py::AscendMoERunner.forward (calls inherited MoERunner._maybe_apply_routed_scale_to_output, whose switch changed from divide_shared_output_in_fp16 to routed_scale_mode)
vllm_ascend/ops/fused_moe/moe_comm_method.py (MegaMoe shared-expert fold logic depends on the runner-owned routed_scaling_factor semantics)
deep_analysis.adaptation_guide:
1) vllm_ascend/patch/platform/patch_fused_moe.py::_ascend_FusedMoE: import RoutedScaleMode; replace the `apply_routed_scale_to_output: bool` parameter with `routed_scale_mode: RoutedScaleMode = RoutedScaleMode.ROUTER`; when building the router via create_ascend_fused_moe_router use `routed_scaling_factor=routed_scaling_factor if not routed_scale_mode.scales_output else 1.0` (this replaces the old `if not apply_routed_scale_to_output else 1.0`); pass `routed_scale_mode=routed_scale_mode` instead of `apply_routed_scale_to_output=...` into `_original_FusedMoE(...)`. Note `_original_FusedMoE` has no `**kwargs`, so keeping the old kwarg raises TypeError for every MoE layer. If Ascend still needs to accept legacy callers, translate an optional `apply_routed_scale_to_output` kwarg into `RoutedScaleMode.OUTPUT`/`ROUTER`, but prefer updating all call sites.
2) vllm_ascend/ops/fused_moe/fused_moe.py::AscendMoERunner.__init__: add `routed_scale_mode: RoutedScaleMode = RoutedScaleMode.ROUTER` (import from vllm.model_executor.layers.fused_moe.config or the package `__init__`) and forward it to `super().__init__(...)`. The post-commit factory passes `routed_scale_mode=` as a keyword to the OOT-dispatched MoERunner, so the current explicit signature (which stops at routed_scaling_factor) will fail construction. The inherited `_maybe_apply_routed_scale_to_output` now reads `self.routed_scale_mode` to decide OUTPUT_FP16_GUARD, so this attribute must be set.
3) vllm_ascend/_310p/fused_moe/fused_moe.py::AscendMoERunner310.__init__: add and forward `routed_scale_mode` to `super().__init__` for the same reason.
4) vllm_ascend/models/glm5next/model.py::Glm5NextMoE: replace the `apply_routed_scale_to_output` constructor param with `routed_scale_mode: RoutedScaleMode = RoutedScaleMode.ROUTER` and pass `routed_scale_mode=` to FusedMoEFactory (preserve the current default behavior, which was False => ROUTER). Update any decoder/MTP call site if it starts passing the flag.
5) vllm_ascend/models/minimax_m3/minimax_m3.py::MiniMaxM3MoE: replace `apply_routed_scale_to_output=True` with `routed_scale_mode=RoutedScaleMode.OUTPUT`.
6) Update stale comments referencing `apply_routed_scale_to_output` in vllm_ascend/ops/fused_moe/fused_moe.py (around the MegaMoe fold-scale logic) and vllm_ascend/ops/fused_moe/moe_comm_method.py so the router/runner scale ownership is documented in enum terms. Custom Ascend MoE models (deepseek_v4, deepseek_v41, kimi_k3, patch_step3p5) do not pass the removed flags and keep the effective ROUTER default, but they must still be sanity-checked because the patched factory now receives `routed_scale_mode` and must translate it before creating the Ascend router.
deep_analysis.risk: High. If patch_fused_moe.py is not updated, every MoE model construction fails immediately with TypeError because `apply_routed_scale_to_output` was removed from FusedMoEFactory and the function has no **kwargs. If the enum mapping is wrong (e.g. routed_scale_mode falls into **kwargs while the wrapper still creates the router with the full routed_scaling_factor), routed_scaling_factor is applied twice (router top-k weights plus runner output) or dropped, silently producing wrong logits. Because AscendMoERunner/AscendMoERunner310 override the runner signature and are OOT-dispatched, missing the new `routed_scale_mode` parameter causes a second construction-time TypeError. The MegaMoe shared-expert path depends on the runner-only scale ownership, so GLM-5/MiniMax/W4A4 shared-expert fusion is the most sensitive correctness surface.

deep_analysis.adaptation_guide: 1) DFlash prepare signature (hard break): upstream now calls prepare_dflash_inputs(input_buffers, ..., block_table, block_size, block_stride, cp_rank, ...) with a new positional block_stride inserted between block_size and cp_rank, and computes it in _prepare_inputs as block_tables.block_sizes[gid], overridden by group.kernel_block_stride * group.kernel_block_size when set. vllm-ascend replaces the module-global vllm.v1.worker.gpu.spec_decode.dflash.speculator.prepare_dflash_inputs with prepare_dflash_inputs_factory(...).prepare_with_block_size (set in AscendDFlashSpeculator.set_attn and AscendDSparkSpeculator.set_attn). That wrapper currently has no block_stride parameter, so the new upstream positional call shifts every following argument (or raises TypeError) and silently produces wrong cp_rank/cp_size/sample args. Add block_stride to prepare_with_block_size, forward it to prepare_dflash_inputs_triton, and keep the Ascend override of block_size from AscendBlockTables.kernel_block_sizes. Because AscendBlockTables expands rows to kernel-block granularity (blocks_per_kv_block), recompute/override the forwarded block_stride to the per-group kernel block size (or group.kernel_block_stride * kernel_block_size when the packed allocation has a kernel stride), rather than reusing the upstream physical-block stride. 2) Triton kernel: add block_stride to prepare_dflash_inputs_triton and _prepare_dflash_inputs_kernel and change _dflash_local_slot from 'block_numbers * block_size + local_positions % block_size' to 'block_numbers * block_stride + local_positions % block_size' for both context and query slots, so draft KV writes land at the same block-stride slots upstream now expects. Keep the DCP/KV_CACHE_BLOCK_SIZE ownership math on the physical kv_cache_block_size. 3) Mirror upstream spec semantics: patch_model_runner.initialize_kv_cache still does 'layer_spec = spec.first_spec ... slot_mapping_enabled.append(layer_spec.uses_slot_mapping)'. After this commit upstream uses 'spec.uses_slot_mapping', and UniformTypeKVCacheSpecs.uses_slot_mapping is now any(spec.uses_slot_mapping for specs) instead of first_spec's value. Change the Ascend copy to use spec.uses_slot_mapping (and keep first_spec only for the other per-layer fields) so mixed Kimi K3 DSpark target/draft groups agree with upstream. 4) Self-addressed caches: upstream replaces AttentionBackend.writes_kv_cache_from_block_table() and AttentionGroup.maps_slot_mapping/kernel_slot_mapping/map_to_kernel_slot_mapping with spec-level uses_slot_mapping=False via SelfAddressedMLASpec, applied to KimiK3IndexerCache and the new K3DSparkAttention (draft MLA). vllm-ascend has no direct references to the removed APIs, but its Kimi K3.1 draft/indexer caches are AscendMLAAttentionSpec/AscendSFAIndexerCacheSpec and its DSpark decoder builds AscendKimiMLAAttention instead of upstream K3DSparkAttention. deep_analysis.risk: High. The new positional block_stride shifts the Ascend wrapper's arguments and can either raise TypeError or, worse, silently mis-bind cp_rank/cp_size and produce wrong KV slot addresses; slot-layout mismatches only surface as corrupted KV/attention output rather than immediate errors. Ascend's kernel-block-addressed BlockTables mean the upstream physical block_stride must not be used verbatim, so choosing the wrong stride (block_size vs kernel_block_stride*kernel_block_size) silently writes draft KV to the wrong pages. commits.comment: ROCm 专用 bugfix：vllm/v1/attention/backends/rocm_attn.py 的 RocmAttentionImpl.do_kv_cache_update 在选择 vLLM 原生 HIP C++ 写 cache 路径（PagedAttention.write_to_paged_cache）时，原条件只有 block_size in (16, 32) 且 has_native_layout；该原生 kernel 每个 token 最多写 512 个 x 元素 chunk，当 num_kv_heads * (head_size // 每个 x 内元素数) 超过 512（如 32 KV heads × head_size 256 的 fp16）时末尾 KV heads 被丢弃（对应 issue #62697）。修复为在条件中追加 self.num_kv_heads * (self.head_size // key_cache.shape[4]) <= 512，不满足时回退到通用路径。同时新增仅 ROCm 生效的回归测试：构造 42 token/32 heads/256 head_size/block 16 的用例，直接调用 do_kv_cache_update 并用 PagedAttention.split_kv_cache 校验所有 head（含 V）被逐元素精确写入。风险局限于 ROCm 注意力后端，行为是“多一层保守回退”，不会改变 CUDA/NPU 路径。

commits.comment: AutoGPTQ 量化 bugfix：此前对 RoutedExperts 一律走 GPTQ/WNA16 量化方法，但 modules_in_block_to_quantize 是从 checkpoint dtype 推导出来的，部分量化模型（例如 MTP 层以 BF16 存储）只列出被量化层的 experts，于是未量化层被错误分配量化方法并去申请 w2_qweight 而 checkpoint 只提供 w2_weight。修复方式：(1) 在 gptq_utils 新增 is_moe_layer_gptq_quantized(prefix, quantized_layers)，通过对名字按 ".experts." 切分得到 expert 父模块名，支持绝对名/块相对名以及 DBRX 那种 runtime prefix 是 experts 父级（...ffn）的情形，做 prefix==parent / suffix / parent.startswith(prefix+".") 的匹配；若配置中完全没有枚举任何 expert 模块则视为“无信息”，默认仍量化以保持兼容。(2) 在 AutoGPTQConfig.get_quant_method 的 RoutedExperts 分支最前面，先用 get_dynamic_override(...) is False 处理负向 dynamic 规则（保证 ROCm 走的 WNA16 fallback 也生效），再判断 is_moe_layer_gptq_quantized，命中则直接返回 UnquantizedFusedMoEMethod。测试新增 150 行，覆盖 helper 语义、Marlin 支持/不支持两条路径（monkeypatch select_wna16_moe_backend 与 check_moe_marlin_supports_layer）、负向 dynamic 规则以及 DBRX 式父前缀。风险较低，但改变了量化方法选择，若某模型 expert 命名不含 ".experts." 且实际已量化，则依赖“无信息默认量化”的兜底。

ascend_impact.functionality: 无影响：变更是 AutoGPTQ/MoeWNA16 的量化方法选择逻辑（vllm/model_executor/layers/quantization/auto_gptq.py、utils/gptq_utils.py），vllm-ascend 使用自有量化体系（vllm_ascend/quantization 的 modelslim/fp8/compressed_tensors/modelopt_mxfp8 方案与 AscendMoEScheme 注册表），不由 AutoGPTQConfig 分配 NPU MoE 的量化方法。

commits.comment: FlashInfer 的 mm-prefix（PrefixLM/双向图像前缀）原生支持：vllm/v1/attention/backends/flashinfer.py 新增 BatchPrefillWithCausalBidirectionalRangesWrapper 路径，用 (N,2) 的 per-token 双向区间代替稠密 mask。关键实现：(1) _native_mm_prefix(vllm_config) 作为统一门控——要求 model_config.is_mm_prefix_lm、DCP size==1（DCP prefill 的 context/new-token 切分破坏区间）、无 attn_logit_softcapping、nvfp4 需 fa2 或 wrapper 支持 v_sf_swizzled（通过 inspect.signature 探测）、SM100 上必须显式选择 FLASHINFER；(2) FlashInferBackend.supports_mm_prefix 暴露能力，get_supported_kernel_block_sizes 在原生 mm-prefix 时禁用 large page/trtllm 路径，validate_configuration 拒绝非白名单 KV-cache dtype 与 sink；(3) MetadataBuilder 新增 max_num_batched_tokens×2 的 CpuGpuBuffer，用 fill_mm_prefix_query_ranges 生成区间，prefill 侧并行 plan 一个 mm wrapper，且 treat_short_extends_as_decodes=not use_mm_prefix 以保证短尾 token 能看到区间内未来 token；(4) Impl.forward 在运行期（Gemma4 会在 forward 前清空 full-attention 组的区间）选择 mm 分支，处理 fa2 不接受 fp8 query/output 的问题（去量化 query、scaled_fp8_quant 后量化 output）以及 sliding window 的 range_window_left 钳制。测试覆盖 Blackwall 上的自动/显式后端选择、nvfp4 需 swizzled V scale，以及 e2e mm_prefix 用例新增 attention_backend=FLASHINFER 参数。风险中等：改动影响后端选择与块大小、trtllm 路径互斥关系，mm wrapper 的 plan 在 build 期完成，需确认 CUDA Graph 捕获/重放下的行为。

commits.comment: 渲染/聊天模板 bugfix：SigLIP2 checkpoint（model_type 为 siglip）复用了 Gemma tokenizer，其自带 chat template 会把 embedding 文本包进对话轮次并丢掉 EOS，导致 pooling/embedding 输入与原始文本不一致。实现：在 chat_templates/registry.py 新增 _MODEL_TYPES_OVERRIDING_TOKENIZER_CHAT_TEMPLATE={"siglip"} 与 get_chat_template_override_path()（内部复用 get_chat_template_fallback_path），并把 siglip2 的 fallback 从 template_basic.jinja 改为 template_siglip.jinja；在 vllm/renderers/hf.py 的 resolve_chat_template 中于“显式 chat_template/显式 --chat-template”之后、AutoProcessor 模板之前插入该覆盖，返回 load_chat_template(path)，从而优先级高于 tokenizer 自带模板（但低于用户显式指定）。测试把 google/siglip2-base-patch16-224 加入 online 双塔 embedding 用例。风险："siglip" 是较宽的 model_type，覆盖会作用于所有 model_type 为 siglip 的 checkpoint，需在 SigLIP2 上游去掉 Gemma 模板后回退该名单（代码注释已标注 tracking 链接）。
